summary: These six sheets contain the electrical legends and installation requirements, drawing specifications, existing distribution one-line, four existing-panel schedules, luminaire schedule and energy compliance documentation, and an overall location plan. The remodel uses existing normal and emergency distribution equipment, with new pharmacy branch circuits and four specifically keyed GFCI breakers. Lighting includes 277V recessed troffers and downlights, 120V task and undercabinet lights, and 277V exit signs; final fixture quantities must be reconciled with E3.01. The specifications include temporary power, selective demolition, circuit tracing, firestopping, design-build fire alarm modifications, and communications rough-in with cabling and devices by others. Hospital operations must remain active, outages require advance coordination, and essential-power commissioning and an updated hospital coordination study are required. No new feeder lengths or underground routes are established by these pages.
